scope: Beijing OpenReel staging read-only reliability observation
target: loopback OpenReel service on the authorized Beijing staging host

window.note: The formal health sampling began at 04:12:28Z after endpoint discovery. Baseline and post-run resource observations extend the authorized observation window beyond 30 minutes.

endpointDiscovery.description: Read-only discovery identified /health/live and /health/ready as the canonical loopback endpoints. Expected negative probes are excluded from the formal service error rate.

limitations: This qualifies a low-risk sustained read-only staging observation only; it does not qualify chaos, tenant isolation, signing, off-host retention, production deployment or rollback.
The SSH control connection was interrupted once; OpenReel remained active, ready, at zero restarts and without resource degradation.
No business endpoint, authenticated workflow, payment path or provider path was exercised.
